title: Parked-mode scheduler classification and registration policy

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Code-only commit containing the canonical scheduler inventory, API registration wiring, runtime policy tests, and static mutation tests. Only proof paths may follow this commit before review.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not PM approval, deployment authorization, or independent certification.

does_not_claim: No GitHub secret was created or changed.
No parked production deployment was performed.
No deployed-SHA, production health, or live producer-containment claim is made.
Deploy/canary/container equality gates are outside this scheduler-policy lane.
UTV2-1610 remains authoritative for whether the live blind-pick producer is contained.

pnpm_verify.detail: Sync, system alignment, automation coverage, environment validation, lint, type-check, build, aggregate tests, command verification, DB smoke, and the full live T1 proof battery passed.

coverage: Only exact true/false values are accepted.
All fourteen production schedulers have one explicit parked-mode classification.
Parked mode suppresses all six syndicate producer stages.
Active mode registers every production scheduler.
Every scheduled work function and setInterval in index.ts is owned by the canonical policy.
Removing the candidate-scoring, ranked-selection, or board-construction gate fails static verification.
Adding an unclassified interval scheduler fails static verification.

root_test.command: pnpm test (as part of pnpm verify)

policy_execution.command: npx tsx -e <execute both scheduler modes through createSchedulerRegistrationPolicy>

pnpm_test_db.command: pnpm test:db (as part of pnpm verify)

broader_live_proof.command: pnpm test:t1-proof:live (as part of pnpm verify)
broader_live_proof.skip_reason: The bounded provider-history assertion observed data older than its 72-hour lookback and classified it as known stale provider data, not a code regression.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Use one canonical scheduler-registration decision rather than independent ad hoc checks.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Every production scheduling site in apps/api/src/index.ts is registered through schedulerPolicy.register with a scheduler id from SCHEDULER_CLASSIFICATIONS.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Parked mode does not schedule board scan, candidate scoring, ranked selection, board construction, board pick writer, or candidate pick scanner.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The parked runtime receipt suppresses exactly those six scheduler ids; the focused suite independently asserts the same decision set.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Every production scheduler is explicitly classified as parked-enabled or parked-disabled, and a new unclassified scheduler fails verification.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Fourteen-entry inventory assertion plus AST-based static verification of all scheduled work and every setInterval site.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Removing the board-construction, ranked-selection, or candidate-scoring gate is detected.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Three independent source mutations replace each canonical registration with an unchecked registration; all three are rejected by the static auditor.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Runtime logging reports the actual syndicate-machine mode.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: index.ts emits scheduler_policy.resolved with schedulerPolicy.mode and all decisions, and includes syndicateMachineMode in the API listening receipt.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Code merge alone is insufficient; secret creation, parked deploy, deployed-SHA proof, service health, and truthful readiness remain required.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: This bundle explicitly limits itself to scheduler-policy runtime behavior and records all production deployment claims as outstanding.

known_limitations: The two new focused test files are executed explicitly because package.json is outside this lane's authorized file scope.
The runtime receipt executes the production policy object without starting the API process; starting the local API would run unrelated parked-enabled DB schedulers against live credentials.
Production deployment and exact-head independent review remain external approval steps.
